---
title: "R workshops"
---

Four workshops, in the order to take them:

1. [R Introduction](intro.qmd): objects, functions, packages, reading data, basic data manipulation and graphs. For people new to R.
2. [R Regression Models](models.qmd): the formula interface, model summaries and predictions, contrasts, and clustered data. Intermediate.
3. [R Graphics](graphics.qmd): `ggplot2` from aesthetics to themes. Intermediate.
4. [R Data Wrangling](wrangling.qmd): iterating over files, writing functions, regular expressions, reshaping. Intermediate to advanced.

Before any of them, follow the [installation page](install.qmd). Each workshop's page links to its materials (data, cheat sheets, a BLANK file to type along in, and the exercise solutions).
